handbookNote: Oregon Revised Statutes Chapter 194 (Notaries Public and Other Officers Performing Notarial Acts), ORS 194.215-194.410 and 194.980-194.990, plus Oregon Administrative Rules Chapter 160, Division 100 (Notaries Public) -- Oregon's notary exam is administered as part of the Secretary of State's commissioning application process, with a state-approved training course required within 6 months before sitting for it -- price matches this project's established Notary tier ($9.99), not a placeholder
